svg.title: Wireframe 5: lifter directory and lifter detail on a phone
svg.desc: Four greyscale phone screens: lifter directory with search, lifter detail with best lifts, total, Sinclair and competitions, one competition with the three judge flags per attempt in fixed order, and a later red-flag-by-judge summary.
svg.text: Wireframe 5 · Lifters and lifter detail · phone (375 px)
Routes: /lifters · /lifters/[lifterId]. Should tier (S2, S4): built after the Must slice. Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders. Names and numbers are made up.
A
Lifter directory (/lifters)
The active club's lifters, grouped by first letter. The
search is the same as the suggestions in Add lifter.
A row opens the lifter's detail page.
B
Lifter detail
Best lifts and total come from the good lifts only.
Sinclair uses the table for the competition's cycle. The
2025–2028 constants are not found yet (context doc §7), so
the 2021–2024 ones are used and the screen says so.
C
One competition, flags per attempt

g.text: Flags, left to right: left, centre, right judge
A lift counts when at least 2 of 3 flags are white.

svg.text: All six attempts with the three judge flags in a fixed order:
left, centre, right. That is why the order is stored. The
result is derived from the flags. Note 94 kg repeated after
a no-lift, which is allowed (R10).
D
Red flags by judge (later)

g.text: Centre judge gave the most red flags.
Shown only when there are at least 10 attempts.

svg.text: Not in the first slice. Counts red flags per judge over many
attempts, so a coach sees a pattern such as 'centre judge:
5 red of 12'. The data needed is already stored.
